solution.en: Check camera power, adapter, LAN cable, PoE switch, and NVR network settings. Restart the camera and NVR, then confirm the camera IP is reachable.
solution.bn: camera power, adapter, LAN cable, PoE switch এবং NVR network settings check করুন। camera ও NVR restart করে camera IP reachable কি না দেখুন।

escalation_message.en: If the camera stays offline, share camera model, NVR model, and network connection type.
escalation_message.bn: camera offline থাকলে camera model, NVR model এবং network connection type লিখুন।

solution.en: Check DVR/NVR power, HDMI/VGA cable, monitor input source, and display resolution. Try another monitor or cable if possible.
solution.bn: DVR/NVR power, HDMI/VGA cable, monitor input source এবং display resolution check করুন। সম্ভব হলে অন্য monitor বা cable দিয়ে test করুন।

escalation_message.en: If there is still no display, share device model and what appears on the monitor.
escalation_message.bn: display না এলে device model এবং monitor-এ কী দেখাচ্ছে তা লিখুন।

solution.en: Clean the camera glass, check IR LED settings, confirm there is enough power, and remove objects reflecting light near the lens.
solution.bn: camera glass clean করুন, IR LED settings check করুন, power ঠিক আছে কি না দেখুন এবং lens এর কাছে light reflect করে এমন object সরান।

escalation_message.en: If night vision still fails, share camera model and a photo of the night image.
escalation_message.bn: night vision সমস্যা থাকলে camera model এবং night image এর photo দিন।

solution.en: Check HDD status in DVR/NVR settings, confirm recording schedule is enabled, format the HDD only after backup, and check date/time settings.
solution.bn: DVR/NVR settings থেকে HDD status check করুন, recording schedule enabled আছে কি না দেখুন, backup নেওয়ার পরই HDD format করুন এবং date/time settings check করুন।

escalation_message.en: If recording is still missing, share HDD status, storage size, and DVR/NVR model.
escalation_message.bn: recording না থাকলে HDD status, storage size এবং DVR/NVR model লিখুন।
